content: Group C features title holders South Africa, who will compete against Ghana and Mali, both of which are returning to the finals for the first time since 2018. Additionally, Tanzania is entering the tournament for only the second time, having made their initial appearance in 2010.
Sakina Ouzraoui: We know all the pressure is on us because the [Wafcon] is being played here and we were finalists at the last one.
